A '''Clawdite''' [[Shape-shifters|shape-shifter]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] took the identity of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone trooper]] [[Sharp (clone trooper)|Sharp]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] during the [[Mission to Kynachi]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. The Clawdite joined [[Breakout Squad]] and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Nuru Kungurama]] along with the crew of the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] ''[[Hasty Harpy]]''. After leaving [[Kynachi]], they became trapped near a [[Black hole/Legends|black hole]] with [[Black Hole Gang/Legends|pirates]], but managed to escape. He had been hired by [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] to sabotage the mission.

The Clawdite and his squad were then sent on a [[Mission to Vaced|mission]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vaced/Legends|Vaced]] to escort Kynachi's [[Commissioner (Kynachi)|Commissioner]], [[Langu Sommilor]]. After landing, Sommilor was assassinated by a [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]]. "Sharp" rescued Kungurama after the latter dueled the sniper at [[Shattered Rock]] canyon. The ''Hasty Harpy'' was shot down by the Death Watch's [[Hudu Shiv's Pursuer-class enforcement ship|vessel]], so Breakout Squad found other transportation to [[Bilbringi Depot]] to search for Kungurama's missing [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], [[Ring-Sol Ambase]]. They did not find Ambase, but they freed the depot from [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] [[Overseer/Legends|Overseer]] [[Umbrag]]. They also once again met the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Ambassador/Legends|Ambassador]] [[Sev'eere'nuruodo|Veeren]]. As she left, her ship was destroyed by one piloted by Ambase, who fled after the incident. "Sharp" almost had his ruse revealed by a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]], but he avoided exposure.

On the voyage back to Coruscant, he was forced to shoot Oveseer Umbrag, who had gotten ahold of Kungurama. Ventress later ordered him to help Umbrag escape. Soon after, in an incident in the [[Dacho District]] on Coruscant, the real Sharp discovered the ruse and tackled the Clawdite. The two fell through a skylight, and the fall [[Death/Legends|killed]] the Clawdite.

==History==
===Mission to Kynachi===
[[File:Sharp-StrangeAllies.png|thumb|right|200px|The Clawdite hunter impersonated Sharp.]]
A Clawdite [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], who could [[Shape-shifters|shape-shift]], took the identity of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone trooper]] [[Sharp (clone trooper)|Sharp]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="TCWSM1">''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 1: Breakout Squad]]''</ref> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="ERC" /> The Clawdite, a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual, surreptitiously replaced Sharp during the [[Mission to Kynachi]] and took the [[Cloning/Legends|Clone's]] place in [[Breakout Squad]], while the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Ring-Sol Ambase]] and Sharp were captured and put in the hands of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]' leader [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. Breakout Squad, the Clawdite, and Ambase's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Nuru Kungurama]] joined with [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Lalo Gunn]] and her [[2JTJ personal navigation droid|navigation droid]] [[Cleaver]] and left [[Kynachi]] in Gunn's [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the ''[[Hasty Harpy]]''.<ref name="TCWSM1" /> The Clawdite took Sharp's place after [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] captured him, and the Clawdite sabotaged the [[Escape pod/Legends|life pods]] during the mission.<ref name="TCWSM4" />

===Black Hole Pirates===
This Clawdite joined Breakout Squad and Captain Gunn on its mission to [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss space]].<ref name="TCWSM2">''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 2: Curse of the Black Hole Pirates]]''</ref> The Clawdite sabotaged the navigation system, causing them to end up near a [[Black hole/Legends|black hole]]<ref name="TCWSM4" /> and experience and their misadventures with the [[Black Hole Gang/Legends|Black Hole Pirates]]. They eventually escaped the black hole and set a course back to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the Republic capital [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="TCWSM2" />

===Mission to Vaced===
{{Quote|Begging your pardon, Commander, but perhaps I should be a lookout? I have sharp eyesight. That's how I got my nickname, you know.|The Clawdite explaining to Kungarama how he got his nickname once again.|<ref name="TCWSM3" />}}
While en route to Coruscant, the Clawdite, still masquerading as Sharp, was conducting a systems check with [[Breaker (Breakout Squad)|Breaker]] on the ''Hasty Harpy.'' Breaker noticed a broadcast signal and thought the ship had a tracking device on it. Republic [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and Jedi [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] contacted the ''Hasty Harpy'' via [[Hypercomm/Legends|Hypercomm]] and asked them to [[Mission to Vaced|divert]] to [[Vaced/Legends|Vaced]] to rendezvous and escort Kynachi's [[Commissioner (Kynachi)|Commissioner]], [[Langu Sommilor]]. The ''Hasty Harpy'' was five hours from Vaced, while Sommilor's ship was six hours away.<ref name="TCWSM3" /> The Clawdite took Sharp's place after [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] captured him, and the Clawdite sabotaged the [[Escape pod/Legends|life pods]] during the mission.<ref name="TCWSM4" />

Once they landed on Vaced, the Clone troopers and Kungarama disembarked the ''Hasty Harpy'' at [[Vaced Spaceport]]. They were confronted by a [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] gang looking to collect insurance payments, but Kungarama used a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] to force them to dispense. "Sharp" then offered to be a lookout, but Kungarama asked him to search the ship for a transmitter. Cleaver found the tracking device but it was forgotten in the following events. The Kynachi leader and his [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] soon landed nearby, but was hit by a [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]] as he was disembarking. The Clones ran for cover while Kungarama chased after the sniper.<ref name="TCWSM3" />

The Clones went back on the ''Hasty Harpy'' to rescue the Padawan after he fought the sniper, a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] member. The ''Harpy'' was attacked by the Mandalorian's [[Hudu Shiv's Pursuer-class enforcement ship|transport]]. The ''Harpy'' shot down the other vessel but was damaged in the process and crashed near Vaced's spaceport. Breakout Squad and Captain Gunn parted ways; the Republic troopers, along with the rogue swoop rider, [[Gizman]], took the deceased Kynachi ambassador's ship. Kungarama had found a belt belonging to his Master, Ambase, which had an [[Imagecaster/Legends|imagecaster]] with coordinates leading to [[Bilbringi Depot]]. The Clones arrived there and captured [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] [[Overseer/Legends|Overseer]] [[Umbrag]]. After the facility was secured, [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] Ambassador [[Sev'eere'nuruodo|Veeren]] arrived. She revealed that it was she who had planted the tracking device Cleaver still carried on his chassis, and that it appeared someone was manipulating Breakout Squad. Kungarama was confused, but Veeren left just as quickly as she arrived. As her ship was preparing to jump to hyperspace, a [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] [[Corona-class transport|''Corona''-class transport]] arrived. Veeren's shp fired on the ''Corona;'' return fire from the Kuat transport destroyed her ship. Kungarama [[Force sense/Legends|Force sensed]] that his missing Master, Ambase, was onboard the ''Corona.'' Breakout Squad could only watch while Ambase's ship fled.<ref name="TCWSM3" />

A hidden [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] then surprised them by shooting Chatterbox in the back. Kungarama bisected the droid with his lightsaber, then ordered the Clones to search the depot for more droids. "Sharp" offered to search the hatch. Once inside the empty corridor, he removed his helmet and reverted to his true form. He thought what would have happened if the droid had shot him instead. Taking a deep breath and replacing his helmet, he adopted his Sharp disguise again and returned to the others.<ref name="TCWSM3" />

===Showdown on Coruscant===
{{Quote|Listen carefully. Umbrag is important to the Separatists. You will help him escape and bring him to me.''"<br />"''Help him!? But he's&mdash;''"<br />"''Do it!''"<br />"''I'm dead.|Ventress orders the Clawdite to help the deceased overseer escape.|<ref name="TCWSM4" />}}
After the battle, the Clawdite contacted Ventress, and gave her an update. She told him she would call again in an hour and signed off. Breakout Squad then boarded Summilor's freighter, bound for Coruscant. During the trip, Umbrag grabbed the young Jedi, forcing the Clawdite to shoot him. At Coruscant, Ventress made contact and ordered the bounty hunter to help the overseer escape, and cut him off before he could explain that Umbrag was dead. Kungurama directed the ship to the [[Dacho District]], where it was damaged. The real Sharp had already arrived with Master Ambase, and when Sharp saw the Clawdite, he tackled the impostor and they fell through a skylight. Sharp fell on top of him, and the Clawdite [[Death/Legends|died]] when he landed. His body was turned over to [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]], but after five days he had not been identified.<ref name="TCWSM4" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Asajjventressheadshot-obsession.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Despite being hired by Ventress, the Clawdite hunter feared his employer.]]
The Clawdite used his natural shape-shifting abilities to impersonate a Clone trooper. "Sharp" often commented on how sharp his eyesight was, which was the basis for his nickname. During the mission to Vaced, the Clawdite's fellow Breakout Squad member Breaker noticed he was acting strange and thought he should go see the [[Clone counselors]].<ref name="TCWSM3" /> The bounty hunter worried that Ventress would kill him if he failed.<ref name="TCWSM4" />

==Behind the scenes==
The second "Sharp" was introduced in the [[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 2: Curse of the Black Hole Pirates|second ''Secret Missions'' book]]. Subtle hints were dropped throughout ''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 3: Duel at Shattered Rock]]'' that the "Sharp" traveling with Breakout Squad was not the real one; he was revealed to be a Clawdite shapeshifter during the book's denouement.
